'''Tofen Vane''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] and a member of the [[House of Vane]] that sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The son of Harko and Elodore Vane, Tofen grew up being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitve]], but his mother along with [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] hid his Force-sensitivity from the Jedi. This allowed Tofen to grow up on Valahari where he became a skilled [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and considered Dooku a close family friend. He married a woman named Omi. Like his father, Tofen grew to resent the Republic, due to it raising in taxes and decided to remain neutral in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

He once [[Podracing/Legends|podraced]] against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hero [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after his father, [[Harko Vane]], [[Death/Legends|died]] in what looked as a Republic attack—which was secretly orchestrated by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] as part of winning Valahari and the House of Vane, of which Dooku was an old friend, over to the side of the Separatists—and become a hero of the war himself.

When Tofen proved highly successful and relentless in his pursuit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republican]] forces, Skywalker engaged him in a dogfight to try and talk some sense into him. Both shot each other out of the sky and crash-landed on a nearby moon, and in their following confrontation, Skywalker finally managed to raise first doubts in Tofen and also have his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] place a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on Tofen's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfigther]]. But even after his mother, [[Elodore Vane]], confronted her son with concrete evidence that Dooku was responsible for his father's death, Tofen refused to give up his determination to fight the Republic.

In the subsequent [[Battle of the Veil Nebula]], Tofen's droid [[XT]] found the homing beacon but allowed it to find them to engaged Skywalker in a dogfight once more. However, during their battle the thrusters of Tofen's [[Tempest Zero/Legends|Tempest Zero]] fighter were critically hit and finally burned out, setting his fighter aflame. Skywalker desperately towed the burning fighter aboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Republic cruiser]] and raced to save Tofen's life, but his burns were too severe. Before expiring in Skywalker's arms, a repentant Tofen asked Skywalker for justice for his father's death. Soon afterward, the Count was gracelessly banished by Elodore Vane.

Ultimately, Skywalker fulfilled his last request when he killed Count Dooku on the ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]'' during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. 

==Behind the scenes==
Tofen Vane is modeled on [[Wikipedia:Manfred von Richthofen|Manfred von Richthofen]] AKA the "Red Baron," a famed pilot of World War I. Vane is piloting a red craft much like the Red Baron, while his uniform displays decorations similar to those of the Imperial German ''Luftstreitkräfte''.
